ABOUT

Comfortable on both sides of the wire.

I'm a Communication and Information Engineering student at Zewail City, and the part of this field that keeps me hooked is the range it demands — one term I'm wiring an 8-bit processor by hand on a breadboard, the next I'm shipping a .NET system that a real transport office now runs its daily paperwork on.

That range is also my USP: most freelancers you'll find are either "the software person" or "the hardware person." I move between both, so a project can stay end-to-end with me — the interface, the database, the electronics underneath it, or the signal processing in between.

Outside coursework, I lead public relations for Techno Map, coordinating events for 400–800+ attendees, and I've spent years in logistics-heavy volunteer roles — the kind that teach you how to keep a lot of moving parts on schedule, which carries directly into how I run client projects.

OFFERED SERVICES

What I can take off your plate.

Turning paper-based workflows into working software

I design and build the database, backend, and interface for teams still tracking orders, invoices, or records by hand — like the transport office system I built and shipped to a paying client.

Connecting your app to real-world data

I build systems that pull from external APIs — climate data, sensors, maps — and turn raw numbers into charts and recommendations a non-technical user can act on.

Prototyping embedded & digital-logic systems

From an 8-bit processor built and verified from scratch to digital circuits that need to be designed, wired, and tested — I'm comfortable moving down to the hardware level.

Cleaning up noisy signals

Biomedical or audio, I apply DSP techniques — adaptive filtering, wavelet decomposition — to pull a clean, usable signal out of a noisy recording.

PROJECTS

Selected work, most impactful first.

01 — PAID CLIENT PROJECT
Petroleum Materials Transport Office System
2025 · Full-Stack · SQL Server · .NET
Problem

The office tracked material transport orders, invoices, and payments entirely on paper — slow to search, easy to lose, hard to report on.

Solution

Architected and built the full stack myself — frontend, backend, and relational SQL Server schema — including invoicing, payments, expenses, and a reporting module filterable by client, provider, location, fuel type, and date range.

In daily use by a paying client
02
ARM-1 Processor Hardware Implementation
2026 · Assembly · Digital Systems · Embedded Design
Problem

Wanted to understand computing at the hardware level, not just the software abstraction sitting on top of it.

Solution

Designed and verified the ALU, register file, control unit, and memory interface, then built the full datapath physically across breadboards with an FPGA-driven control unit, covering the entire fetch-decode-execute pipeline.

03
Weather Oracle — NASA Extreme Weather App
2025 · Full-Stack · .NET · Data Analytics
Problem

Anyone planning an outdoor event or trip months out has no easy way to gauge extreme-weather risk beyond a short-term forecast.

Solution

Built a location-based system that estimates extreme-weather probabilities from 30 years of NASA climate data, with an interactive map, charts, and plain-language recommendations.

04
ECG Signal Denoising for Telemedicine
2026 · MATLAB · DSP · Biomedical Engineering
Problem

ECG signals sent over low-bandwidth telemedicine links pick up baseline wander, powerline interference, and EMG noise that can obscure the QRS complex doctors rely on.

Solution

Designed a denoising pipeline combining adaptive filtering and wavelet decomposition tuned to preserve QRS morphology, evaluated against the original signal using SNR and RMSE across the time domain, power spectral density, and spectrogram.

05
River Raid — 2D Game
2025 · C++ · OOP · Game Development
Problem

Wanted to go beyond a typical class project and ship something with production-level touches, not just a working prototype.

Solution

Built enemy spawning, collision detection, a fuel system, and scoring, plus pause/resume and persistent save/load of game state.

06
Restaurant Management System
2025 · C++ · Data Structures
Problem

Restaurant order queues across VIP, vegan, and normal tiers need fair, efficient scheduling instead of manual tracking.

Solution

Built a queue-based order management system that simulates real-world operational scheduling and priority handling.

07
Quiz Generator
2024 · Python · GUI · JSON
